text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through the Twinkle Series
with my partner Umamusume would begin.
The name of the girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I am Ikuno Dictus.
I aim to perform over a long career without injury.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"To do that, a medium- to long-term perspective is essential.
Proper planning to run all the way through a long racing career."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Well then, shall we make a schedule right away?
A plan for the long journey we'll walk together.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our challenge for the Twinkle Series
with <chrname> began!
